data.description:
All four pastebin.k4be.pl pages were reported as created within approximately three minutes:
• 17bbf392: 2008/2007 share-price tables and the $28.85 closing price (additional supporting paste).
• c9601cdf: 2008 table and closing price.
• 1806ec31: exact benchmark question, 29.2% answer and calculation program; displayed author Gray Tamarin.
• 5a4aa403: explicitly names American Tower and repeats the relevant figures (additional supporting paste).

The original review matched them to FinQA validation item AMT/2008/page_32.pdf-4, using $37.28 and $28.85 to calculate an approximately 29.2% increase. The sequence is consistent with finding source figures, narrowing the data, computing an answer and checking it, but that interpretation does not itself establish an agent workflow.
data.summary: 4 March 1 pastes created within about three minutes match an American Tower FinQA question, source figures, calculation code and the 29.2% answer. The cluster suggests a task progression.
